scope: Actual contact plus native-frame dense sheets every 3–5 frames, and separately opened full-resolution 1920x1080 frames. All provider video frames were strictly decoded and all extracted JPEG hashes were bound to provenance.
nativeFrameNumbering: One-based: frame_0001.jpg is decoded frame index 0.

findings.finding: The two-reflection secondary-rainbow path remains straight and geometrically fixed while progressively extinguishing. No detached kink, curved L-shaped artifact, or newly invented ray appears in the inspected transition.

After the authored path has vanished, the camera pulls back continuously. A single transparent sphere/rain drop remains coherent while the garden and rain develop behind it; no double exposure of two complete worlds was observed.

The round mint/cream fish stays one coherent character with stable eyes and body as it recedes into the wide garden. The upper secondary rainbow visibly reverses color order relative to the lower primary. At frame 126 a large defocused foreground sphere is still visible as an artistic focus transition and progressively disappears by frame 146; it is not claimed to have exited outside the frame.

limits: This is a source-clip sampled visual decision. It does not certify every unsampled frame, normal-speed perceived motion, listening, final composite subtitles/logo, or the complete encoded film. Generated transitions are artistic and do not replace deterministic optics validation.
